subject: Validation request: pen test closure, delta fixes, and auditor verification - Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: post-fix validation letter + delta summary for recent pen test

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again — our penetration test with RedTeam Labs wrapped last week. We've implemented fixes for the two remaining findings listed on page 7 of the report: an S3 bucket ACL misconfiguration and an OAuth redirect validation gap. Our auditor has asked for either a retest report or a short verification letter from the vendor confirming remediation and the scope of revalidation (delta-only).

Can Redwood provide an auditor-facing verification letter (one page) that confirms: 1) the retest scope was limited to the two findings; 2) the tests were performed after the fixes; and 3) the results observed (remediation confirmed / residual risk low). If you can also supply a short delta summary and the revalidation artifacts (screenshots / log snippets), that would be ideal.

We've attached our remediation tracker (remediation_tracker_nimbus.xlsx) for reference. Timeline: our SOC 2 auditor expects evidence by 2027-03-22.

Appreciate a timeline and point of contact.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Security Lead, Nimbus Health
alex.mercer@nimbushealth.com

Attachment: remediation_tracker_nimbus.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: post-fix validation letter + delta summary for recent pen test

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the tracker.

Looping in our security leads (Vivek and Laura) to coordinate the validation and the auditor-facing wording. Vivek: can you confirm whether Redwood will run the delta verification in-house or if we should engage RedTeam Labs to provide the verification artifacts and letter? Our goal is to deliver an auditor-ready PDF and the screenshots/logs by 2027-03-22.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: ops@redteamlabs.io
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Validation run: Nimbus Health delta - scope and evidence ask

Hi RedTeam Ops,

Per conversation with the customer (Nimbus Health) and our AE, please perform a scoped revalidation focused only on the two remediated items: 1) S3 ACL fix; 2) OAuth redirect validation. Acceptance criteria:
- Confirm vulnerability no longer reproducible using the original test cases.
- Provide time-stamped screenshots and the exact request/response traces (sanitized) used for verification.
- Produce a short auditor-facing verification letter (PDF, one page) addressed to "Nimbus Health" stating the date of revalidation, limited scope, and result (remediation confirmed/mitigated).
- Include a delta summary (1–2 pages) listing what was rechecked, test results, and residual risk rating.

Please also attach any scripts/commands used (as text) and a checksum for artifacts. Target completion: 2027-03-15 COB PST. If there are scope concerns or cost changes, flag immediately.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: RedTeam Labs <ops@redteamlabs.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Validation run: Nimbus Health delta - scope and evidence ask

Vivek / Karthik — confirming completion of the scoped validation for Nimbus Health (delta-only).

Summary:
- S3 ACL: tested with original PoC (sanitized). Bucket now returns 403 for the prior request pattern. Screenshots and request/response traces attached.
- OAuth redirect: tested redirect vectors from report. Redirect parameter validation now correctly rejects open redirect attempts. Logs and curl traces attached.

Artifacts included: nimbus_pt_delta_summary_v1.pdf (auditor-facing verification letter + 2-page delta), revalidation_screenshots_20270315.zip (screenshots and sanitized traces), verification_commands.txt (commands and sanitized outputs).

Attestation excerpt (from the verification letter): "RedTeam Labs performed a limited revalidation of the two issues identified in the original engagement report and confirms that remediation was in place at the time of testing (2027-03-15). This verification is limited to the scope described herein and does not constitute a full re-engagement."

If Nimbus or your auditor needs any clarifications or expanded artifacts, we can provide a time-window for live verification or additional logs.
